BRCA1 is associated with hereditary breast and ovarian cancer syndrome, the best-characterised of its disease links.

The current MedGen record describes an autosomal dominant inheritance pattern.

Biallelic BRCA1 variants have also been reported in Fanconi anemia complementation group S, drawn from literature.
